tree.aboutTitle: G-math was founded to give every student in Israel an equal opportunity to grow.
tree.aboutBody:
The project was founded out of the vision of Sarah Grazutis, a veteran mathematics teacher – to make the worlds of numbers and shapes accessible to every student.

Out of an understanding of the challenges of learning, especially for students who struggle to concentrate or persevere, the site brings together hundreds of high-quality presentations and lessons, personally tailored to different levels. Here, everyone can find a new and accessible approach to mathematics – one that makes it possible to overcome obstacles and succeed.
